concepts.gloss_en: the one who gives charity (the charity-giver)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are vocalized identically as הַנּוֹתֵן צְדָקָה and both mean 'the one who gives charity' — in lm1:31 mapped to 'east' as the giver, and in lm1:116 as the giver saved from transgressions. Same word, same sense, no homograph split needed.
